items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I know he's good. I know he's good. I know he's good. Louis come from the home. From Jones home.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I know he's good. I know he's good. I know he's good. Louis come from the home. From Jones home. Many of them did.
Yeah. Jones is throwing a lot of good trumpet players out there now.

Gooder than that. Yeah, every day. Thomas Chappison. Thomas Chappison. Yeah. Now Bichet was lying right around my house clarinet. And Paul Bond was lying right at my house with a flute. One of them little silver flutes, them little flutes, them little flutes, and they were little silver flutes, them little flutes. Which kind?
